message.text: Tracing the filter-to-SQL pipeline through engine.go, render.go, and helpers.go AppendConditions, plus dialect-specific memo.go files for Postgres and MySQL.

Checking schema.go for memo filter fields and render.go for SQL rendering.

Also checking engine.go or schema.go for DefaultEngine.

The filter syntax is CEL (Common Expression Language). It is documented in proto files and implemented via cel-go.

The engine lives in `internal/filter/` (`engine.go`, `parser.go`, `schema.go`, `ir.go`, `render.go`). Cel-go compiles the filter string into an AST. The engine converts it to a dialect-agnostic condition tree in `ir.go`. `render.go` renders that tree into dialect-specific SQL. Each dialect driver calls `filter.DefaultEngine()` and `filter.AppendConditions` with its `DialectName` to append the WHERE clause.
